title: Tabgha campaign: remote endpoint and small local fallback
goal: The approved packs run on Tabgha against the Mac models over models.remote and against qwen2.5:1.5b and qwen2.5:3b locally
acceptance: Runs recorded with base and model identity, latency and timeouts, including Neo Tokyo-3 asleep
Memory pressure on the mini PC recorded, not hidden
privacy: Reports stay private under artifacts/; only metadata (identity, counts, outcomes) enters Git. No prompts, replies or credentials.
escalation: A model campaign runs only inside the scope and budget the owner approved in F-078-T02
A model failure that NERV can fix becomes a B- record with a failing test first

effort.basis: Split 2026-11-13 into one-actor steps (harness 8.10.0); hours unchanged in total.
